label: BMS ingest
info: P15 simulated BMS ingestion. Subscribes campus/# from the MQTT broker, validates against the shared contract (contracts/validation_rules.json), maps topics to canonical point_id via the point registry, batch-inserts into TimescaleDB, routes malformed messages to bms.dead_letter, and raises staleness alerts.

name: validate + map point_id
batch 500 / 5 min
insert readings (upsert)
query:
INSERT INTO bms.readings (ts, point_id, value, unit, quality)
SELECT (x->>'ts')::timestamptz, x->>'point_id', (x->>'value')::double precision, x->>'unit', x->>'quality'
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS x
ON CONFLICT (ts DESC, point_id) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, quality = EXCLUDED.quality;

name: heartbeat params
upsert last_seen
query:
INSERT INTO bms.points (point_id, last_seen)
SELECT x->>'point_id', (x->>'last_seen')::timestamptz
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS x
ON CONFLICT (point_id) DO UPDATE SET last_seen = EXCLUDED.last_seen;

name: dead letter params
dead letter
query: INSERT INTO bms.dead_letter (topic, payload, reason) VALUES ($1, $2, $3);

name: raise staleness alerts
query:
INSERT INTO bms.alerts (point_id, alert_type, severity, detail)
SELECT p.point_id, 'STALENESS', 'critical',
       'no valid samples for ' || FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - p.last_seen)) / 60)::text || ' min'
FROM bms.points p
WHERE p.last_seen IS NOT NULL
  AND now() - p.last_seen > INTERVAL '10 minutes'
ON CONFLICT (point_id, alert_type) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL DO NOTHING;
